subject_session: Achilles_10252013 (main); Achilles_11012013, Cicero_09102014, Gatsby_08282013 as intended replications

headline_stat.name: POST significant-replay fraction vs calibrated control (main session)

stated_limitation: Replay is a minority of events, which is expected: short bursts with few active cells carry too little information to score, and the detection rate rises steeply with the number of participating cells

justification.dataset: DANDI:000044 Grosmark & Buzsáki dorsal-CA1 recordings are the canonical dataset for hippocampal replay and place-cell sequences.
justification.handling: Real NWB files streamed with remfile, excitatory units, NREM-restricted ripple detection, and lap/epoch alignment are all correct and explicitly justified.
justification.analysis: Standard Bayesian decoding scored by weighted correlation against two shuffle nulls plus a template-permutation calibration control that lands at the nominal 5%, which is a rigorous and appropriate design.
justification.correctness: Main-session numbers reproduce from the committed pipeline and are consistent with the figures, with only a minor README-vs-figure discrepancy (5.4 vs 5.6 cm) and pooled cross-session statistics left as unfilled placeholders.
justification.figures: Figures are readable with units and sample sizes, decoding validation is convincing, and the example events are ranked by the effect strength (|weighted correlation|) itself rather than an unrelated criterion.
justification.honesty: The headline single-session result is proportionate, calibrated against an empirical control, and caveated as a minority effect, but the write-up overstates completeness by describing a four-session pooled replication whose figure/CSV are absent and whose stats paragraph still contains literal template placeholders.
